correctness.rationale: Expanding the exact published vector field at p4 gives alpha'=(m+n)alpha/sqrt(2)+higher terms and beta'=-beta/sqrt(2)+alpha^2/(4sqrt(2))+higher terms. The unstable-manifold invariance equation therefore forces beta=alpha^2/[4(2(m+n)+1)]+O(|alpha|^3). The exact coordinate definitions give q-1=alpha^2/2+O(alpha^4) and r-1=alpha^2/[2(2(m+n)+1)]+O(|alpha|^3), proving the ratio limit. Using q=r+x r' yields xw'=2(m+n)w+O(w^(3/2)); standard asymptotic integration gives w=Cx^(2(m+n))(1+o(1)) with C>0 on the nontrivial branch.

value.rationale: The source's classification distinguishes the end only by its limiting angle. The new theorem identifies the exact first nonzero transverse order, which grows with the total symmetry dimension and is invariant under dilation. This is a structural local invariant of the classified family, not a numerical refinement: it separates mere tangency from increasingly high-order contact and gives a reusable asymptotic boundary model for the zero-mean-curvature profiles.
